name: California

jury_list.holder: Superior court jury commissioners (Code Civ. Proc. 195-196).

sources.cite: Code Civ. Proc. 196 (jury commissioner inquiry into qualifications; information noted in commissioner records)

voter_file.who_may_get: Candidates, ballot-measure committees, and any person for election, scholarly, journalistic, political, or governmental purposes as determined by the Secretary of State (Elec. Code 2194(a)(3)), after a written application under penalty of perjury (Elec. Code 2188).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Election, scholarly, journalistic, political, or governmental purposes. Not for any personal, private, or commercial purpose, and not for reproduction or display on the internet (2194(a)(2)).
voter_file.use_restriction: Elec. Code 2194(a): the affidavit of voter registration information '(2) Shall not be used for any personal, private, or commercial purpose, including, but not limited to: (A) The harassment of any voter or voter’s household. (B) The advertising, solicitation, sale, or marketing of products or services to any voter or voter’s household. (C) Reproduction in print, broadcast visual or audio, or display on the internet or any computer terminal unless pursuant to paragraph (3). (3) Shall be provided with respect to any voter, subject to the provisions of Sections 2166, 2166.5, 2166.7, 2166.8, 2166.9, and 2188, to any candidate for federal, state, or local office, to any committee for or against any initiative or referendum measure for which legal publication is made, and to any person for election, scholarly, journalistic, or political purposes, or for governmental purposes, as determined by the Secretary of State.'
voter_file.attestation_required: Application with name, addresses, phone, ID number, the information requested, and a statement of intended use, certified under penalty of perjury (Elec. Code 2188(b), (e)).

sources.cite: Elec. Code 2188 (application; statement of intended use; penalty of perjury)

private_challenge.who: Only a member of the precinct board may challenge, at the polling place. 'A person, other than a member of a precinct board or other official responsible for the conduct of the election, shall not challenge or question any voter concerning the voter's qualifications to vote' (Elec. Code 14240(b)).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Elec. Code 14240. Lists sent to precinct board members need probable cause and must go to the elections official first (14240(c)).

county_board.name: California county elections offices (Secretary of State)
county_board.note: The county elections official cancels a registration 'upon proof that the person is otherwise ineligible to vote' (Elec. Code 2201(a)(8)).

gates.basis: Jury records: status unknown (null), so counts only. California bars private persons from challenging voters (Elec. Code 14240(b)). Voter data use is limited and may not be put online (2194).

notes: private_challenge.allowed is false: Elec. Code 14240(b) forbids anyone except precinct board members and election officials from challenging or questioning a voter's qualifications.
Use limit: JuryRoll matching must fit an election, scholarly, journalistic, political, or governmental purpose stated under penalty of perjury (2188, 2194). The app should warn California users.
